DEVELOPMENT CASE STUDY / 04

Building parcel booking around the whole operation

OrganisationUK Mail
Project datesAugust 2011 – January 2013
RoleContract full-stack developer

THE WORK

Shipment booking, payments, labels and back-office tools brought together in one ecommerce platform.

Historical software development experience.

The requirement

The parcel-booking service needed to bring together shipment booking, payment and label production, with back-office functions to support the operation.

Our contribution

Our work covered the ecommerce platform and its supporting systems. The project included integrations with Barclays ePDQ, PayPal, eBay and Google, together with tools for reporting, data management and voucher creation.

What was delivered

A parcel-shipping ecommerce platform connecting the customer booking journey with payment services, printable labels and back-office administration.

Why this experience matters

Customer-facing features depend on the systems behind them. This experience demonstrates work across those boundaries, from the interface through to external services and operational tools.
